answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 84 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. The nebula register is checked at draw time, jade lists the eligible set, and ferrous seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 84 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. A 289 account operation therefore ties up 10 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
